description: Obtains a PointClickCare access token on a timer and reads the organization's facilities as a liveness check, pushing a status message downstream. With two-legged OAuth there is nothing to persist: the token is short-lived and can be re-obtained at will, so it is held in memory only.

config.label: Interval
config.description: How often, in milliseconds, to re-check the connection. 900000 is fifteen minutes. The token is cached in memory and only re-fetched when it nears expiry, so this costs little.

config.label: OAuth Mode
config.description: 2-legged authenticates the application with client_credentials and needs nobody to sign in, which suits an unattended feed. 3-legged authenticates a person and carries their privileges. The two grants live on different hosts with different transport requirements, so this setting also picks the default URLs below.

config.label: Client ID
config.description: PointClickCare application Client ID (the Customer Key). Left blank on purpose.

config.label: Client Secret
config.description: PointClickCare application Client Secret (the Customer Secret). Stored encrypted.

config.label: Organization UUID
config.description: Optional. PointClickCare returns the organization with the token, so this is normally discovered rather than configured. Set it only to pin a specific organization.

config.label: Client Certificate File
config.description: Path to the client certificate, relative to the Linkiir working directory. REQUIRED for 2-legged: connect2 enforces mutual TLS and rejects a request without one. Must be a certificate issued for client authentication; a self-signed one is refused.

config.label: Client Key File
config.description: Path to the private key for the client certificate. Must be set together with the certificate, or the handshake fails with a misleading error.

config.label: CA File
config.description: Optional trust anchor for verifying PointClickCare. Leave blank to use the system store.

config.label: Redirect URI
config.description: 3-legged only. Where PointClickCare sends the browser after sign-in. Must match the portal registration exactly and must be https.

config.label: Auth Base URL
config.description: Leave blank to follow OAuth Mode: connect2 for 2-legged, connect for 3-legged. Pairing a grant with the wrong host is the most common first-connection failure.

config.label: API Base URL
config.description: Leave blank to follow OAuth Mode. Set only to pin a different API version or a proxy.

config.label: Request Timeout
config.description: Seconds to wait for a PointClickCare response.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, requests are prepared but never sent, and calls report themselves as simulated. Lets an imported adapter be inspected before it touches a real tenant.
